people.name: Pertinax

roles.t: Prefect of a cohort in Syria
Governor of Moesia, Dacia, Syria, Britain

people.summary: Son of a freedman from Alba Pompeia who rose through equestrian and then senatorial commands under Marcus Aurelius, governed four provinces, and was made emperor on the night Commodus was strangled (31 December 192). He reigned 87 days.
people.detail:
Pertinax tried to restore Antonine austerity: he sold Commodus's luxuries at auction, cut court spending and promised the Praetorians less than they expected. On 28 March 193 some 200 to 300 guardsmen stormed the palace and killed him; the guard then sold the throne to Didius Julianus. Septimius Severus took his name, deified him and staged a magnificent funeral to present himself as the avenger, a claim Cassius Dio, who witnessed it, describes in detail.

In Britain (185-187) he had nearly been killed suppressing a legionary mutiny, which earned him a reputation for severity with soldiers that the Praetorians remembered.
people.death: killed by mutinous Praetorians in the palace on 28 March 193
